question: The germinal centers are areas where lymphocytes proliferate:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: B cells -> germinal centers -> lymphocyte proliferation -> 95% CHAIN: Th cells -> germinal centers -> lymphocyte proliferation -> 90% CHAIN: NK cells -> do not typically proliferate in germinal centers -> 5% CHAIN: Tc cells -> do not typically proliferate in germinal centers -> 95%
analysis: Germinal centers are specialized areas within secondary lymphoid organs where B lymphocytes proliferate, differentiate, and undergo somatic hypermutation to produce high-affinity antibodies.
